decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and numbered Cover Letter (DB/110068/L0001), Noise Assessment (dated 27 Oct 2011), Site Plan, Received 2 November 2011, Email from Darren Brown, Received 11 January 2012and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the extension is occupied.

Condition : 3 - No vehicles shall enter the site in connection with the use of Unit 4, or activities take place outside Unit 4 (within the Phoenix Trading Park site), outside the hours 0700 to 2300 Monday to Saturday, or outside the hours 1000 to 1600 on Sundays, Bank or Public Holidays.

Condition : 4 - The site shall only be used for purposes under Class B1(b), Class B1(c), Class B2 and Class B8 of the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 or purposes directly ancillary thereto unless otherwise approved by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The parking, loading and turning spaces approved in front of Unit 4 in 00505/Y/P36 shall be maintained and such spaces shall not be used for any other purpose.
Condition : 6 - There shall be no means of access (vehicular or pedestrian) to the site (excluding the electricity sub-station) from Springvale Avenue.

Condition : 7 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Development Order) 1995 (or any order revoking or re-enacting that order), no further extensions or additions shall be constructed without the prior permission of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 8 - There shall be no heavy goods vehicle deliveries to Unit 4 on Sundays, Public or Bank Holidays.
description: Variation of Condition 1 of planning permission 00505/Y/P37 approved on 09/11/2006, to enable unit 4 to be used on Sundays and Bank/Public holidays between the hours of 10am and 4pm.
